prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: RequestResponder.cancel() violates the MCP spec: it incorrectly sends an error response when a request is cancelled (forbidden by spec) and never sends the required notifications/cancelled message to the peer. (2 PRs)

prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: UrlElicitationRequiredError is not pickle-safe because Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs via cls(*self.args) where self.args=(code, message, data), mismatching the subclass constructor signature (elicitations, message=None), causing TypeError on unpickle (issue #2431).
